newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer mulls fate of Bre-X offer.
newsitem.headline: Placer mulls fate of Bre-X offer.

text.p: Gold miner Placer Dome Inc said Monday it was studying whether to press ahead with its proposal to merge with Bre-X Minerals Ltd.
"The merger proposal is still there. We're considering whether it is viable to go ahead with it," said Placer spokesman Hugh Leggatt.

Placer announced last month a US$5.0 billion offer to merge with Bre-X in hopes of winning rights to develop its huge Busang gold discovery in Indonesia. Bre-X announced earlier Monday it reached a deal to develop the project in a consortium with Freeport McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc.
